newsitem.title: ITALY: HPI, Marzotto detail share swap.
newsitem.headline: HPI, Marzotto detail share swap.

text.p: Newly formed Italian industrial group Holding Partecipazioni Industriali (HPI) and textiles group Marzotto detailed the planned share exchange for their proposed merger.
The plan envisages 13 ordinary HPI shares at a nominal 500 lire for one ordinary Marzotto share with a nominal value of 1,000 lire.
It also sees eight non-convertible HPI savings shares for one non-convertible Marzotto savings share.

HPI, which has just completed its spin-off from financial holding Gemina, and Marzotto said this weekend they intend to merge to form Gruppo Industriale Marzotto, which they said will be one of the largest textile and clothing groups in the world.

"As a result of the share exchange, the terms for exercising the 1998 warrants exercisable into HPI ordinary shares will be amended to entitle holders of these warrants to subscribe for ordinary shares in Gruppo Industriale Marzotto on the basis of 65 warrants for each such share at a price of 9,750 lire," a joint statement said.
The statement said the proposed exchange ratio had been reached after valuations put on Marzotto of 1.067 trillion lire and of 3.307 trillion on HPI.
